results.note: Inverts the no-hunks guard: files with real conflicts short-circuit as clean, clean files fall through.
Drops the ancestry facts from the cache key: two different ancestries collide on one cached answer.
Drops base_kind from the fingerprint: an inferred base and a supplied base share a cache entry.
Changes the cache namespace, silently orphaning every existing cache entry.
--ai-refresh no longer bypasses the cache: the stale answer is served anyway.
A cache entry with no raw_response is treated as a hit, KeyError-ing instead of falling through to the backend.
A well-formed fenced json block is discarded, so every fenced answer is reported as no-JSON.
The proposal check runs only on already-failed parses; a clean parse is never validated against hunks or rules.
A rejected record carries the ours bytes as its proposal instead of empty, so a bad answer looks like a real proposal.
The accepted proposal is written to disk but its record is never persisted.
Sub-line reports are built from the first hunk only; every later hunk's report is lost.
